name: Micro SaaS Examples

sources.title: Submit page — form plus Basic $3 / Featured $29 / Sponsored $147 tiers

requirements: Product should be a micro SaaS; every submission is manually reviewed before publishing
Cheapest tier (Basic, $3) requires embedding a permanent backlink badge on your landing page
Featured ($29) and Sponsored ($147) tiers do not require a badge
preparation: Product name, contact email, product URL (the only form fields)
Ability to paste the provided badge code onto your landing page if choosing Basic
workflow: Fill product name, contact email, and product URL

Pick a tier: Basic $3 (permanent listing, reviewed within 7 days, backlink badge required), Featured $29 (no backlink, one do-follow link), or Sponsored $147 (24h review, 30-day homepage/category feature, 2 newsletter mentions)
If Basic: copy the badge code onto your landing page
watchFor: There is no $0 lane — even the $3 Basic tier is paid AND demands a permanent backlink badge
Badge/backlink requirement is enforced on Basic; removing it presumably risks delisting
Sponsored tier's 'featured for one month' window is the only expiring benefit
countsAsLive: Product appears on the /p index and relevant category page with a do-follow link
unknowns: Refund policy if a submission is rejected
Precise definition of 'micro SaaS' used for eligibility
